findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_services, get_contact, submit_brief, ask_goce_agent · Private data: get_contact, submit_brief · Public sink: get_contact, request_intro, submit_brief, ask_goce_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_services, get_contact, submit_brief, ask_goce_agent · Private data: get_contact, submit_brief · Public sink: get_contact, request_intro, submit_brief, ask_goce_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
